scope: Standalone helper and focused software tests for function.validate, selection.rebind, and definition.mapping_validate. No shared dispatcher/registry/Worker files.

acceptance.mapping_destination_frame_property: UNOBSERVED; evaluation frame spatial bound only

scope_notes: The arithmetic map evaluator is a labeled partial preview; only cpltag(x/y/z) sampled through result.at_points is an operator-value witness.

The actual evaluator requires an explicit dataset, solution tag, outer and inner pair, spatial destination frame, coordinate unit and expected source unit. The current result.at_points adapter refuses time/frequency/parameter selectors.
A successful finite sample set does not prove GeneralExtrusion source-mesh coverage, and COMSOL 6.4 GeneralExtrusion has no verified dstframe property.
Interpolation method order is reported separately from sampled data availability; boundary neighbors and caller-selected discontinuity probes are finite checks, never a global continuity guarantee.
Selection rebinding only targets an existing named Box/Ball with read-back geometry identity and exact geometry length unit; entity IDs are not claimed stable across geometry revisions.
All tests here use synthetic API-shaped fixtures; no COMSOL engine/model or GUI was started.
